name: CallFlaggedParts
evidence: Slot 16: for kinds 0x515..0x519, calls slot 6 of every one of its nine parts whose flag is set.

name: SetupCurrentObjectChoices
evidence: deferred call set up by BecomeCurrentObject: creates the four paired objects, finds the highest choice whose levels entry allows it, picks the starting choice and calls SetCurrentObjectChoice

name: BecomeCurrentObject
evidence: Slot 16: stores itself in D_0026FCF0 after loading and registers the callback func_0016AB38 with its level.

name: ShowCurrentObjectCaptions
evidence: sets D_0026F138's text to the name string, an empty string or the stored one from the choice's levels flags, and shows or hides D_0026FA90 with its start prompt string

name: MoveCurrentObjectChoice
evidence: steps the object's choice at +0x2D0 by one in the direction of the stick axis func_0016EC98 returns (wrapping between 0 and the limit at +0x2FC when that is 5), then calls SetCurrentObjectChoice

name: ConfirmCurrentObjectChoice
evidence: for a choice not yet taken starts the object's element and sound for it (func_0012C7B0, func_001F0428, func_001E9570) or plays its sound, then calls SetCurrentObjectChoice with 1; func_0016B580 calls it for the confirm buttons 0x140

name: SetCurrentObjectChoice
evidence: stores the choice a and the sub-choice b at +0x2D0 and +0x2D4 with the clock at +0x2D8, requests a sound from the table D_00262890 for a choice newly reached, and sends the matching ids from D_00262860 to the object at +0x2E0

name: InitSelectionCaption
evidence: slot 1 of D_002212E0: SetupScreenElementText, takes a frame from func_0015C1C0(2), clears the node and sound and sets lastAt to -D_00262970

name: RestoreSelectionCaptionCamera
evidence: while the selection caption is open, pushes the camera controller of object 0x4FD (FindFirstObjectByIdMode4, PushObjectCameraController); RunPendingWorldLoad calls it

name: HandleSelectionCaptionInput
evidence: slot 4 of D_002212E0: per frame with the pad record, releases the held node's handle, shows the captions and answers the pad bits 0x800 (opens the pause menu), 0x140 (ConfirmCurrentObjectChoice) and otherwise MoveCurrentObjectChoice

name: SetSelectionCaptionOpen
evidence: slot 3 of D_002212E0: on opening sets the node's choice and runs func_0016E0F0 and func_0016EC88, on closing stops the sound handle, runs func_0016E118 and hides both captions

name: DrawSelectionCaption
evidence: slot 9 of D_002212E0: draws the frame box and the text with the colour alpha scaled by blend and a scale pulsed by func_00205400 of the clock

name: InitGridSelector
evidence: slot 1 of D_00221330: SetupScreenElementText, clones the font at scale 1.0, measures a 0x5F-wide string at scale 1.3 and sizes the element with SetScreenElementSize

name: TestGridEntryBit
evidence: returns the bit n (0 to 15) of the 16-bit word at +0x19F4 of the game state (0 for n of 16 or more)

name: HandleGridSelectorInput
evidence: slot of D_00221330 given the pad record: closes on 0x9B0, runs the entry on 0x40, and moves the cursor over the 4 by 4 grid by the stick axes with wrap-around in both directions

name: SetGridSelectorOpen
evidence: slot 3 of D_00221330: on opening runs func_0016E0F0 and func_0016EC88 and sets the cursor to the highest bit set in the word at +0x19F4; on closing runs func_0016E118

name: DrawGridSelector
evidence: slot 9 (the draw slot DrawGauge and DrawPauseMenu fill) of the grid selector's method table D_00221330: draws each grid entry's movie title (GetMovieTitle, DrawFontString) with a pulsing scale on the chosen one (Sine, PushFontScale) and the lines between them (DrawLineSegment), testing each entry's bit (TestGridEntryBit)
